faqs.q: Does Make have a free plan?
faqs.a: Yes. Make Free includes 1,000 credits a month. Paid plans start at $9 a month for 10,000 credits on Core.

faqs.q: Which Make alternative bills per run?
faqs.a: n8n. One execution is one run of the whole workflow, however many steps it has. Starter is €20 a month billed yearly.

faqs.q: Can I move Make scenarios to another tool automatically?
faqs.a: No. A blueprint is a .json file you can import elsewhere in Make. In another tool you rebuild, starting with the busiest scenario.
